findings.summary: The new Link component types children as React.ReactNode but never imports the React namespace, so the file fails TypeScript compilation.
findings.scenario: `npm run build` or `tsc` in the frontend -> TS2686/Cannot find namespace 'React' in HelpDialog.tsx, blocking the build.
findings.fix: Import `type ReactNode` from "react" and use `children: ReactNode`.

findings.summary: Paths are interpolated into single-quoted PowerShell literals without doubling apostrophes, so an install/data path like C:\Users\O'Brien breaks the swap script (and allows PowerShell injection via the path).
findings.scenario: App installed under C:\Users\O'Brien\NovaSolverStudio -> SWAP script contains $app = 'C:\Users\O'Brien\...' -> syntax error, update never applied; crafted folder name executes arbitrary PowerShell.
findings.fix: Escape single quotes ('' ) or pass paths via -File/-EncodedCommand arguments or environment variables instead of string interpolation.

findings.summary: Global shortcuts still fire while the new HelpDialog is open because the guard checks s.palette but not s.help.
findings.scenario: Open Help and press Ctrl+Z -> undoCase() runs and mutates the case behind the modal; h/x also hide faces or toggle see-through.
findings.fix: Add `!s.help` to the shortcut guard and handle Ctrl+K only when no modal is open.

findings.summary: Check-then-act race: state is only set to 'applying' after Popen, so two concurrent update requests both pass the 'ready' guard and spawn two swap scripts on the same folders.
findings.scenario: User triggers update twice (double click / client retry) -> both requests read state=='ready' -> two PowerShell scripts rename/move NovaSolverStudio concurrently -> half-moved install / data loss.
findings.fix: Guard and flip _job to 'applying' under a threading.Lock before launching Popen; abort if not idle.

findings.summary: _download catches only OSError/ValueError/BadZipFile; any other exception (http.client.HTTPException like IncompleteRead, RuntimeError from an encrypted/unsupported zip, KeyError on metadata) kills the thread leaving _job['state']='downloading' forever.
findings.scenario: Server truncates the response body -> IncompleteRead is raised inside _get -> thread dies, state stays 'downloading' -> start_download() returns status() unchanged and never retries until app restart.
findings.fix: Wrap the whole _download body in try/except BaseException and always set state='error' with the exception name.

findings.summary: startUpdate's 500ms poll interval is only cleared on a successful status reply; if api.updateStatus keeps throwing (e.g. backend restarts/dies mid-download) it polls forever.
findings.scenario: Start an update, then the backend is restarted by applyUpdate or crashes -> updateStatus rejects -> catch 'keep polling' -> a request every 500ms for the rest of the session (log spam / resource leak).
findings.fix: Track failure count or an abort flag and clearInterval after N consecutive errors; also clear updatePoll in startUpdate's catch before returning.

findings.summary: The non-portable fallback also catches kind "other" and shows the pip/Python update instructions, which are wrong for other install kinds.
findings.scenario: Backend returns `kind: "other"` -> HelpDialog displays t("update.python") and possibly a pip command instead of a generic download page.
findings.fix: Handle `kind === "python"` explicitly; for `other` show the generic page/message.

findings.scenario: Japanese or Chinese UI -> screen-reader users hear "Close" in English; the update-toast close button has the same issue.
findings.fix: Use a localized close label key for both close buttons.

findings.summary: load_state() may return a non-dict from state.json (e.g. a JSON array); {**load_state(), **kw} then raises TypeError, so /api/update/settings and check return 500.
findings.scenario: state.json contains '[]' (corrupt/hand-edited) -> POST /api/update/settings -> TypeError: 'list' object is not a mapping, auto-check cannot be toggled.
findings.fix: In load_state, return {} unless isinstance(parsed, dict).

findings.summary: _valid_latest accepts an empty windows_zip.urls list because all() over an empty sequence is True, so an update can be advertised with no URL to download.
findings.scenario: latest.json with "urls": [] -> check reports an update available, download then has no URL and fails/does nothing.
findings.fix: Require a non-empty list of URLs in _valid_latest.

findings.summary: The final Start-Process runs even when the swap failed because the app folder stayed in use, so it launches a second instance of the app that never exited.
findings.scenario: On this run the app does not exit within the retry budget -> 'app folder stayed in use' throw -> catch writes result, then Start-Process launches NovaSolverStudio.exe again while the old instance is still running.
findings.fix: Only restart when the folder was actually swapped or the backup was restored; skip Start-Process when the busy-retry path threw.

findings.summary: After a successful update the old app folder (NovaSolverStudio.old-<version>) is never deleted, so every update leaves a full copy behind.
findings.scenario: Several updates over time -> STUDIO_ROOT.parent accumulates NovaSolverStudio.old-0.6.3, .old-0.6.4, ... consuming disk with no cleanup.
findings.fix: On the success path remove $old (or keep exactly one previous backup and prune the rest).

findings.summary: The \\?\ extended-path prefix is built by plain concatenation, which is invalid for UNC roots (needs \\?\UNC\server\share), so long-path unpacking fails when the staging dir is on a network share.
findings.scenario: Portable app on \\fileserver\apps\NovaSolverStudio (writable parent) with a deep target path -> Path('\\\\?\\\\fileserver\...') is not a valid path -> mkdir/open raise OSError, update always errors.
findings.fix: If base is a UNC path (str(base).startswith('\\\\')), prefix with '\\\\?\\UNC\\' and strip the leading '\\\\'.

findings.summary: status() copies the shared _job dict without holding _lock while the worker thread clears and updates it, so pollers can observe an empty/partial dict with no 'state' key.
findings.scenario: GUI polls /update/status just as start_download does _job.clear() -> response has no 'state' -> UI treats job as idle/lost.
findings.fix: Take _lock inside status() (and when updating _job from callbacks) before copying.

findings.summary: _allowed_url accepts http://127.0.0.1: URLs that come from the remote latest.json, letting a tampered document point the updater at local HTTP services.
findings.scenario: modified latest.json with a 127.0.0.1:port URL -> the app fetches the 'update zip' from a local service over plain http.
findings.fix: Only allow http://127.0.0.1: for the URL taken from NOVASTUDIO_UPDATE_URL, not for URLs inside latest.json.

findings.summary: If subprocess.Popen raises, the opened swap.out.log handle is leaked and _job.state is never set, leaving a silent 'ready' state after a 500.
findings.scenario: powershell missing/blocked -> Popen raises -> exception propagates, out file descriptor not closed, state stays 'ready'.
findings.fix: Wrap Popen in try/except; close the file and reset/raise explicitly on failure.
